messages:
Jordan Miles: Heads-up: launching a limited preview of Private Data Processing Mode (PDPM) for Private/VPC installs — targeted at customers needing strict processing controls and auditability.

Hana Kim (Product): PDPM = defaults that minimize telemetry, enforce consented compute lanes, and write immutable audit events to customer-controlled storage. Pilot next month.

Ravi Patel (Security): Key controls: default-deny egress, per-tenant processing policies, KMS-bound snapshot exports, and signed attestations for each processed job. Spec: https://internal.redwood/pdpm-spec (internal).

Priya Kapoor (Legal): For external messaging avoid absolutes like "we don't retain". Suggest: "PDPM minimizes telemetry, gives customers control over audit artifacts, and provides opt-in export & erase operations." Need final dataflow diagrams before any customer-facing comms.

Jordan Miles: Migration notes: opt-in, no infra rollout required for the agent; enabling PDPM triggers a one-time snapshot handshake if KMS is configured. We provide a dry-run mode and a 72-hour validation window.

Hana Kim (Product): We'll select ~10 pilot customers. DM me if you have candidate accounts. Planning a webinar + technical Q&A two weeks before pilot starts.

Support Bot: deploy: pdpm-preview v0.1 -> staging completed :white_check_mark:

Ravi Patel (Security): Action items: security to finalize attestations API (Ravi), legal to sign off wording (Priya), product to prepare pilot invites and webinar (Hana), support to draft migration playbook (Support).

Jordan Miles: Please add any known blockers to the runbook and ping me for escalations. We'll publish KB and a customer FAQ after legal sign-off. :lock:
